method: Independent inspection of actual original 053 and six frozen final renders. Compared V8 hero and V7 rolled front. Opened saved source in Blender 4.3.2 read-only; verified frozen files and packed map bytes. Diagnostic-first-pass excluded.
improvements: Stone is visibly darker and faceted rather than V8 pale cream; crystal channel is wider and more legible.
Raised and overlapping cleavage forms replace some smooth V7 shell areas.
Guard anchors are narrower and material values better distinguish stone, metal and grip.

remainingDefects.finding: Large regular polygon divisions and long pale straight bevels remain. Original has smaller uneven stacked chips, ragged perimeter notches and overlapping mineral plates. Current outline is too clean and its surface resembles paneling.
remainingDefects.repair: Break broad cells into uneven overlapping stone plates with source-located edge chips; vary bevel widths and remove long continuous pale seams.

remainingDefects.finding: Uniform pale-purple central strip looks opaque and evenly faceted; source shows deep violet glassy facets, irregular split exposures and internal highlight variation.
remainingDefects.repair: Model nonuniform crystal fracture sections and tune physically plausible material/lighting while preserving actual mesh depth; do not use image substitution.

remainingDefects.finding: Dark symmetrical crown collar is simpler than source fitted bronze trim with angular anchors and stone inclusions. Pommel is a regular faceted pod with a large uniform crystal face.
remainingDefects.repair: Rebuild individual fitted guard pieces and asymmetric layered pommel stones from the component views.

remainingDefects.finding: Gray grip with regular thin diagonal strips lacks brown leather overlap and local wear. Rolled views approximate sheet direction but do not calibrate camera or align landmarks.
remainingDefects.repair: Refine wrap overlap and grain; publish a clearly labeled view comparison with measured landmarks before claiming silhouette parity.

limitations: No GLB/glTF exists in the frozen candidate; no new runtime or export test claimed.
UV/material presence is structural evidence, not unwrap quality or visual acceptance.
No render regenerated by reviewer; no character grip/stow, collision, LOD or performance validation.
V8 and V9 normal/roughness values did not substantiate the initial gamma-corruption hypothesis. Do not claim a gamma bug was fixed.
Camera roll is approximate, not a calibrated image match.
acceptance: OPEN; continue geometry and material repairs before promotion.
